evidence.decision: Selects standard pattern by event meaning, physical intensity/sharpness by metaphor and repetition by task/hardware suitability.
evidence.artifact: Requires event-to-pattern/timing/hardware/fallback map and concrete revised tactile logic or specification.
evidence.transformation: Sketch example removes prolonged stroke vibration and false Success-on-failure, restoring brief meaningful boundaries and visual recovery.
evidence.verification: Checks absent hardware, disabled haptics, rapid cues and sensor coexistence; misleading semantics and tactile-only essentials fail.
evidence.applicability: Distinguishes built-in actuators, Pencil, Mac trackpad and controller support; Watch named patterns and physical comfort require hardware evidence.
evidence.handoffs: Feedback supplies channel strategy and Gestures supplies action coupling only when needed.
evidence.distinctiveness: Actuator provenance, pattern meanings and synchronization with physical metaphors distinguish haptics from generic feedback.
